new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Ready to build your career? We want to hear from you.

Under the leadership of the Vice President, Integrated Management Systems, the Director, Enterprise Solutions – Finance and Operations is responsible for the strategy, evolution, operations, and value creation of the platforms that support Pomerleau’s finance functions and construction operations.

This mandate includes platforms that support accounting, payroll, accounts payable and receivable, procurement, project financial management, and construction operations. It encompasses both the operation and enhancement of current platforms, including CMiC and Procore, as well as the transformation associated with the deployment of the new financial system and the future PMIS.

The Director defines the portfolio roadmap, ensures business continuity throughout the transformation, and prepares the processes, data, integrations, teams, and operating model required to support future platforms.

Working closely with the Finance function and Construction business units, the Director translates business priorities into functional and technology capabilities, ensuring that platforms effectively meet organizational needs.

The Director leads the functional and technical teams, as well as external partners, responsible for platform evolution, integration, operations, and support. They are accountable for platform stability, performance, user adoption, and the value generated for the organization.

What you will do

Finance And Construction Operations

Act as the owner of the portfolio of platforms supporting Finance functions and Construction Operations.
Be accountable for the satisfaction of Finance functions and Construction business units with respect to the capabilities provided.
Understand challenges related to accounting, payroll, accounts payable and receivable, procurement, project financial management, and construction execution in order to guide priorities.
Ensure that business functions and operating sectors have the platforms, data, and processes required to achieve their objectives.
Continuously measure and improve the value generated by the platforms.

Portfolio Strategy And Evolution

Define the long-term vision for Finance and Operations platforms.
Develop a multi-year roadmap aligned with corporate objectives and the priorities of Finance functions and Construction business units.
Anticipate the evolution of financial practices, including payroll, accounts payable and receivable, accounting, procurement, project management, and construction operations.
Define the investments and priorities required to evolve the portfolio.
Maintain the right balance between business continuity, immediate needs, and future capabilities.

Finance And PMIS Transformation

Play a leading role in the design and deployment of the new financial system and future PMIS.
Ensure the continuity, stability, and evolution of CMiC and Procore throughout the transformation.
Plan the transition, data migration, integrations, and coexistence of current and future platforms.
Partner with Finance functions and Construction business units to transform processes and realize expected business benefits.
Prepare teams, operating models, and internal capabilities required to support the new platforms.
Manage risks, dependencies, and operational impacts associated with the transformation.

Practice Leadership

Lead the functional, technical, integration, and development teams responsible for the platforms.
Develop the internal capabilities required to operate and evolve the portfolio.
Oversee capacity planning and resource management for internal teams and external partners.
Foster a culture focused on service excellence, business partnership, accountability, and value creation.

Software Governance And Architecture

Establish functional and technical governance for the platforms within the portfolio.
Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards and technology frameworks.
Provide direction on platform configurations, custom development, integrations, and extensions.
Collaborate with architecture, data, integration, and cybersecurity teams to ensure robust, secure, and scalable platforms.
Ensure consistency of processes, data, and integrations across the portfolio.

Delivery And Operational Performance

Be accountable for the availability, stability, security, and performance of the platforms.
Ensure initiatives are delivered on time, within budget, and achieve expected outcomes.
Implement governance and performance monitoring mechanisms at the operational, tactical, and strategic levels.
Manage risks, issues, and dependencies across the portfolio.
Ensure the quality, adoption, and business value realization of deployed platforms.

Vendor And Partner Management

Define the strategy for leveraging software vendors, systems integrators, consultants, and specialized partners.
Manage relationships with strategic vendors and partners.
Participate in contract negotiations and agreement management.
Optimize value delivered by external partners and the cost of platforms and services.
Establish a sustainable balance between internal capabilities and external expertise.

This role could be for you if you have

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum of 10 years of experience managing complex enterprise platforms.
Significant experience with an ERP, financial system, or PMIS.
Experience with solutions supporting multiple financial functions, including accounting, payroll, accounts payable, accounts receivable, procurement, and project financial management.
Strong understanding of financial and operational processes and their translation into integrated technology capabilities.
Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and external partners.
Experience managing large-scale transformation programs.
Experience in construction, infrastructure, or a project-based environment is considered a strong asset.
Experience in platform governance and strategic vendor management.

Key Competencies

Strategic leadership
Customer focus and value creation
Understanding of financial functions and processes, including payroll, accounts payable, and accounts receivable
Understanding of construction operations and project management
Enterprise platform management
Governance and portfolio management
Change and transformation management
Executive communication
Stakeholder influence and management
Vendor and partner management
Strategic thinking and decision-making
Collaboration and pragmatism

Benefits

RRSP with up to 5% employer matching
Hybrid work model for corporate roles
Employee stock ownership program
Career growth through real development opportunities
Transit pass reimbursement — get to work for free
Minimum 4 weeks of vacation from day one

For the past six years, we've proudly held the distinction of being one of Canada's Top 100 Employers.

Pomerleau is a national leader in construction, delivering major projects across Canada. We believe in creating a workplace where people feel respected, supported, and empowered to grow. Our culture is built on collaboration, trust, and a shared commitment to doing great work. new_jobs.title: Director, Artificial Intelligence, Finance
new_jobs.description:
Overview

AtkinsRéalis is looking for a Director, Artificial Intelligence, Finance to turn the potential of AI into measurable improvements in how Finance works and how the business makes decisions.

This is a hands-on leadership role. The Director will define a practical AI strategy, identify the opportunities worth pursuing and lead a disciplined portfolio from business case through adoption and verified results. They will also personally design, build, test and help deploy practical Finance agents and AI-enabled workflows within approved enterprise environments.

Success means tangible outcomes: capacity released for higher-value work, faster and better-informed decisions, stronger controls, improved cash performance and protection of project margins. The role is not about deploying technology for its own sake or accumulating pilots that never change how Finance operates.

Leading a small team with a global mandate, the Director will bring together Finance leaders and process owners with the Financial Systems Centre of Excellence (CoE), IT, Global Digital, the Chief Digital Officer's'organization, and data, cybersecurity, privacy and risk specialists. They will develop Finance-specific strategy and governance within enterprise standards, not create competing platforms or policies.

You are a business-led AI and transformation leader who combines strategic ambition, financial discipline and genuine hands-on ability. You can inspire executives, challenge a weak business case and align Finance, Digital, IT and control teams. You are as comfortable discussing strategy as you are building an agent to test an idea with users.

Your role

Set The Strategy And Build Alignment

Define and communicate a value-first AI strategy and roadmap for Global Finance, aligned with Finance priorities, enterprise AI strategy, technology standards and the Financial Systems roadmap.
Determine where AI can materially improve outcomes, where conventional automation or process redesign is preferable, and where an opportunity should not proceed.
Build a shared agenda across FP&A, Controllership, Project Finance and other Finance teams; engage regional and business leaders to identify needs that can scale.
Advise Finance leadership on investment choices, dependencies and risks; secure sponsorship and rally teams that do not report to the Director.

Own a Disciplined Portfolio Of Use Cases

Establish transparent intake and prioritization connected to enterprise channels and governance; assess business value, process and data readiness, feasibility, adoption, total cost and risk.
Maintain a sequenced portfolio with named sponsors, accountable process owners, delivery partners, milestones and clear decisions to proceed, change direction or stop.
Prioritize a few opportunities with a credible path to impact over a large collection of pilots. Candidate areas include reporting commentary, Finance knowledge access, exception handling, forecasting support, collections and project-margin early warning; each requires its own assessment and business case.

Make The Business Case And Prove The Return

Require proportionate business cases before material investment, with baselines, expected benefits, implementation and ongoing costs, risks, dependencies, adoption assumptions and alternatives.
Distinguish time saved from capacity genuinely redeployed and from cost removed; do not treat these as interchangeable financial benefits.
Agree measurement methods and benefit owners before delivery; track investment and realized value at use-case and portfolio levels, with independent validation where appropriate.
Report candidly on adoption, net value, cost and control effectiveness; recommend whether to improve, scale or discontinue initiatives that underperform.

Build, Test And Demonstrate Solutions Personally

Personally design, build and refine selected Finance agents and AI-enabled workflows, especially early prototypes and focused solutions that accelerate learning.
Use Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio hands-on to configure agents, test them with users, assess reliability and improve outputs based on feedback.
Use AI tools regularly in professional work to improve analysis, research, drafting and workflow execution, applying appropriate review and data-handling requirements.
Turn Finance problems into working demonstrations; assess limitations and costs, and decide whether a solution should stop, improve or enter the approved production route.
Stay close enough to delivery to challenge designs, troubleshoot barriers and coach builders, without being the sole developer of enterprise-scale products; partner with Digital and IT on supported deployment.

Establish Practical, Responsible Governance

Translate enterprise AI policy and standards into a Finance operating model covering ownership, intake, risk assessment, testing, approvals, human oversight, monitoring and lifecycle management.
Partner with Digital, IT, the Chief Digital Officer's'organization, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Legal, Risk and Internal Audit to clarify decision rights and navigate the path from idea to approved production use.
Protect sensitive Finance and client information through appropriate access, validation, traceability and human review before AI outputs inform reporting or decisions.
Work with data and process owners on source quality, definitions and controls; reuse approved enterprise platforms and challenge unnecessary complexity without bypassing security or technology accountabilities.

Deliver Through Partnership And Adoption

Directeur(trice) Principal(e) de la Technologie et de l'Innovation

À propos de Crowe BGK

Depuis 75 ans, Crowe BGK S.E.N.C.R.L. est un chef de file de confiance en matière de services de comptabilité et de conseil au Canada. Notre équipe compte plus de 250 professionnels qui servent nos clients à partir de nos bureaux de Montréal et d’Ottawa. Nous offrons des services d’audit, de fiscalité, de conseil et de consultation, aidant les particuliers et les sociétés privées à relever des défis complexes. Nous sommes fiers d’avoir été nommés parmi les 100 meilleurs employeurs de PME au Canada et parmi les meilleurs employeurs de Montréal, car nous croyons qu’il est essentiel de créer un milieu de travail où les gens se sentent soutenus, valorisés et inspirés à progresser.

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) Directeur(trice) Principal(e) de la Technologie et de l'Innovation

expérimenté(e) et pratique pour aider Crowe BGK à maintenir un environnement technologique fiable et à faire progresser l’utilisation des logiciels à l’échelle du cabinet. La personne retenue combinera une compréhension des processus d’affaires, une discipline opérationnelle et une expertise technologique afin d’améliorer le service à la clientèle, l’efficacité, l’évolutivité et l’expérience employé.

Vous Serez Responsable De

Stratégie et gouvernance des logiciels d’entreprise

Élaborer et maintenir la feuille de route pluriannuelle des applications du cabinet, l’inventaire des logiciels, le modèle de propriété et la gouvernance pour la sélection, les accès, les changements, les intégrations, les renouvellements et le retrait.
Identifier les lacunes en matière de capacités, les dédoublements, les outils sous-utilisés ou non pris en charge ainsi que les occasions émergentes; conseiller le ou la COFO, les associé(e)s et la direction sur les priorités, les investissements, les compromis, la normalisation et les coûts.

Amélioration des processus d’affaires et innovation

Analyser et repenser les processus dans les services à la clientèle et les fonctions corporatives, en mobilisant les parties prenantes afin de résoudre les irritants, les lacunes de contrôle, le travail à refaire, les problèmes de données et les besoins non satisfaits avant l’automatisation.
Utiliser les données et les commentaires pour prioriser les améliorations à forte valeur ajoutée et évaluer les flux de travail, l’automatisation, l’analytique, l’intelligence artificielle et les technologies émergentes en tenant compte de la confidentialité, de la qualité, des contrôles et de la supervision humaine appropriés.

Évaluation des logiciels et analyses de rentabilité

Traduire les besoins d’affaires en exigences mesurables sur les plans fonctionnel, technique, des données, de la sécurité, de l’intégration, des contrôles, du service et des utilisateurs; diriger les démonstrations, les projets pilotes, les vérifications de références, les grilles d’évaluation, la diligence raisonnable des fournisseurs et la comparaison objective des risques et des solutions de rechange.
Préparer et présenter des analyses de rentabilité pour les décisions d’aller de l’avant ou non, couvrant le coût total de possession, le rendement du capital investi, les échéanciers, les ressources, l’incidence du changement, la formation, l’atténuation des risques, le soutien et les coûts de sortie; soutenir les négociations commerciales et contractuelles.

Gouvernance et responsabilité de la mise en œuvre

Agir à titre de responsable imputable du volet affaires et technologie, en partenariat avec le ou la gestionnaire de projet attitré(e), afin de définir la portée, les résultats, le budget, les ressources, la gouvernance, les jalons, les droits décisionnels, les risques, les communications et les mesures de succès.
Coordonner les parties prenantes et veiller à la conception des processus, à la configuration, aux intégrations, à la conversion des données, aux essais, aux contrôles, à la formation, à la mise en production, au soutien, à la préparation, à la stabilisation, à l’adoption et à la réalisation des bénéfices; faire remonter les lacunes importantes et maintenir la visibilité auprès de la direction.

Gestion du portefeuille, des fournisseurs, des données et des risques

Gérer les budgets logiciels, les licences, l’utilisation, les renouvellements, les fournisseurs, les contrats, les niveaux de service, les indicateurs du portefeuille, la rationalisation et le retrait des solutions.
Collaborer avec les ressources en TI, cybersécurité, protection de la vie privée, affaires juridiques et gestion des risques afin d’encadrer les intégrations, les données, les contrôles d’accès, la continuité des activités, les risques liés aux tiers, l’intelligence artificielle et l’automatisation.

Leadership du changement et mobilisation des parties prenantes

Établir des relations de confiance avec les associé(e)s, les dirigeant(e)s, le personnel, les fournisseurs et les prestataires de services; diriger les employé(e)s attitré(e)s et les équipes interfonctionnelles en assurant une responsabilisation claire et une forte orientation vers le service.
Diriger les communications, la formation, l’adoption, la documentation, le soutien et la propriété des applications; développer des ambassadeurs internes, contribuer au plan d’affaires du cabinet et tenir le ou la COFO ainsi que les parties prenantes informés.

Autorité et responsabilité

Responsable du portefeuille de logiciels, de la feuille de route des applications, des normes de gouvernance et de la direction des équipes de mise en œuvre des TI et des processus dans le cadre de la stratégie et des budgets approuvés; peut exiger les examens appropriés en matière d’affaires, de sécurité, de protection de la vie privée, d’intégration, de contrôle et de mise en œuvre.
Recommande la sélection, le séquencement, le renouvellement, l’expansion, la consolidation ou le retrait des logiciels; peut suspendre ou faire remonter les préoccupations non résolues et est responsable de la qualité des recommandations, de la gouvernance de la mise en œuvre, de l’adoption, de la stabilisation et des bénéfices approuvés.

Mesures de succès

Gérer un inventaire à jour des logiciels, une propriété claire, une gouvernance rigoureuse, une feuille de route approuvée, des analyses de rentabilité crédibles et des dépenses contrôlées.
Réaliser les mises en œuvre avec une gouvernance, une préparation, des contrôles, une adoption et un soutien durable efficaces, ainsi qu’avec la réalisation des bénéfices approuvés.
Obtenir des améliorations mesurables en matière d’efficacité, de capacité, de qualité, de fiabilité des données, d’expérience employé et client, de performance des fournisseurs, de gestion des risques et de confiance des parties prenantes.

Les Qualifications Qui Comptent

Baccalauréat en systèmes d’information, administration des affaires, comptabilité, finance, informatique, génie ou dans un domaine connexe; une combinaison équivalente de formation et d’expérience sera considérée.
Sept années ou plus d’expérience progressive en logiciels, systèmes d’affaires, amélioration des processus, transformation technologique, gestion de produits ou gestion de programmes, dont au moins trois années dans un rôle de leadership ou de responsabilité à l’échelle de l’entreprise.
Une expérience dans un cabinet comptable ou un autre environnement de services professionnels est privilégiée, avec une compréhension des décisions dirigées par les associé(e)s, du service à la clientèle soumis à des échéanciers, de la confidentialité et du changement entre les groupes de pratique.
Succès démontré dans la direction d’évaluations de logiciels, d’analyses de rentabilité, de sélection de fournisseurs et de mise en œuvre de solutions SaaS à l’échelle du cabinet ou de l’entreprise.
Expérience pratique de la cartographie et de la refonte des processus, des exigences, des essais, de la formation, de la gestion du changement et de la réalisation des bénéfices.

Vous Pouvez Compter Sur Nous Pour

Une rémunération compétitive
Un modèle de travail hybride flexible
Des assurances collectives complètes dès le premier jour d’emploi pour soutenir votre bien-être global
Des vacances généreuses et 8 journées personnelles pour responsabilités familiales
Des fermetures du cabinet pendant les Fêtes pour décrocher pleinement
Des vendredis d’été avec fermeture hâtive durant la saison estivale
Stationnement gratuit sur place ou remboursement du transport en commun
Une allocation annuelle mieux-être pour soutenir la santé physique et mentale
Une allocation pour l’aménagement du bureau à domicile afin d’assurer un environnement confortable et productif
Une culture de bureau dynamique et accueillante, où les chiens sont les bienvenus et où l’énergie est au rendez-vous. Entre les 5 à 7 animés, les cours de spinning hebdomadaires, les ateliers de peinture en équipe, les soirées quiz et karaoké, il y a toujours une activité rassembleuse. Sans oublier notre Camp Crowe, une expérience estivale unique remplie d’activités amusantes qui favorisent la camaraderie et créent des souvenirs mémorables

Si vous cherchez un endroit où vos idées comptent et où votre carrière peut s'épanouir, postulez dès aujourd'hui!

Cultivez votre curiosité. Inspirez votre esprit. Façonnez votre carrière.

Nous maintenons un environnement de travail inclusif et offrant des chances égales afin que chaque professionnel de Crowe BGK puisse réaliser son potentiel d'évolution. Nous considérons tous les candidats qualifiés pour un emploi sans distinction de race, de couleur, de religion, de sexe, d'orientation sexuelle, d'identité de genre, d'origine nationale, d'âge, d'état matrimonial, de handicap, de statut d'ancien combattant protégé ou de tout autre facteur protégé par la loi.

Nous remercions tous les candidats pour leur intérêt et nous ne contacterons que ceux que nous souhaitons poursuivre.

For 75 years, Crowe BGK LLP has been a trusted leader in accounting and advisory services in Canada. We are a team of 250+ professionals serving clients from our Montreal and Ottawa offices. We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on Director of Software Technology and Innovation

to help Crowe BGK maintain a reliable technology environment and advance the use of software across the firm. Lifemark Health Group (LHG) is a market leader in customized healthcare solutions. As a national healthcare company, LHG employs over 5,000 highly trained clinicians, medical experts and team members in almost 400 locations coast-to-coast and continues to grow both organically as well as through acquisitions. Lifemark was acquired by Loblaw Companies on May 10, 2022.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a strategic, collaborative, and results-oriented Director, HR Transformation, Systems and Analytics to lead the evolution of Lifemark's HR operating model, technology capabilities, and people analytics function.

Reporting to the Vice President, People & Culture, this role will provide strategic leadership across HR transformation, systems, process optimization, data governance, and workforce analytics. The Director will be responsible for developing and executing a roadmap that strengthens HR operational effectiveness, establishes scalable processes and controls, improves data quality, and enables more informed people and business decisions.

A key priority will be leading Lifemark's readiness for a future Workday implementation, ensuring that HR processes, data, governance, systems, and organizational capabilities are positioned for successful transformation. The role will also oversee the effectiveness and continuous improvement of existing HR platforms while identifying opportunities to leverage technology, automation, and responsible AI to improve efficiency and the employee and manager experience.

Working closely with People & Culture leadership, Operations, Finance, Payroll, IT, Talent Acquisition, and Enterprise partners, the Director will translate business priorities into practical, sustainable solutions, lead cross-functional initiatives, and build the capabilities required to support Lifemark's continued growth and evolution.

Identify and prioritize opportunities for process simplification, automation, and continuous improvement across People & Culture.
Lead transformation initiatives associated with organizational growth, acquisitions, integration activities, and evolving business requirements.
Develop business cases, implementation plans, success measures, and executive recommendations to support transformation investments and priorities.

HR Systems Strategy & Workday Readiness

Develop and maintain an HR technology roadmap that balances current operational requirements, system optimization, future-state capabilities, and long-term transformation priorities.
Lead the development and execution of Lifemark's Workday readiness roadmap, establishing clear milestones, accountabilities, dependencies, risks, and decision points.
Assess organizational readiness across HR processes, data quality, governance, integrations, reporting, security roles, permissions, change impacts, and operating model requirements.

Oversee the prioritization, planning, testing, and implementation of enhancements to existing HR systems, including configuration changes, workflow improvements, reporting capabilities, and process automation.
Establish appropriate governance and controls for HR system administration, access management, data maintenance, system changes, and issue resolution.
Identify and address foundational process, data, and governance gaps that may impact the success of future HR technology implementations.

Ensure effective change management, documentation, training, and stakeholder readiness for HR system and technology initiatives.

new_jobs.description:
Director of Clinical Informatics – Enterprise EHR/CIS Implementation

Program:
Symbio – Provincial Clinical Information Solution Program
Client:
Department of Health, Government of New Brunswick (GNB)
Location:
Remote, with travel to New Brunswick at least once per month
Contract Duration:
November 2, 2026 – November 1, 2028, with one optional one-year renewal
Work Schedule:
Full-time
Maximum Rate:
$120 per hour, based on a standard 7.5-hour workday

Position Overview

The Department of Health, Government of New Brunswick, is seeking an experienced Director of Clinical Informatics (BA3)
to support the Symbio Provincial Clinical Information Solution Program. Symbio is a province-wide healthcare transformation initiative focused on replacing fragmented hospital information systems, paper-based clinical records, and disconnected applications with a unified, standardized, and integrated Clinical Information Solution (CIS).
Reporting to the Chief Clinical Information Officer (CCIO) for the Symbio Program and working closely with the CCIO and Chief Nursing Information Officer (CNIO), the successful candidate will establish, mature, and sustain the clinical informatics capabilities, operating methodologies, governance structures, and delivery practices required for the program.
This senior leadership role will oversee the day-to-day delivery of clinical informatics activities across a multi-site acute care health system, ensuring that provincial clinical workflows are standardized while accommodating approved local variations across large, medium, and small hospitals. The Director will bridge clinical stakeholders, physicians, nursing professionals, clinical operations, informatics specialists, and technical EHR/CIS build teams to ensure that the solution reflects approved clinical requirements and supports patient safety, clinical quality, operational readiness, and effective clinician adoption.
The successful candidate will also mentor New Brunswick program personnel, transfer knowledge, and develop sustainable internal capabilities to support the long-term operation and continuous improvement of the provincial clinical information solution.
Key Responsibilities

1. Clinical Informatics Strategy and Program Delivery

Work with the CCIO and CNIO to establish and maintain a sustainable clinical informatics operating model, methodology, and integrated workplan aligned with the Symbio Prepare, Adopt, and Improve journey.

Lead the day-to-day execution of clinical informatics activities across steady-state operations and project-based initiatives.

Establish transparent oversight of milestones, deliverables, progress, risks, dependencies, priorities, and escalations.

Provide regular status and risk reporting to the Department of Health.

Coordinate clinical informatics resources, activities, and priorities to support the program's overall objectives.

2. Provincial Clinical Workflow Standardization and Localization

Develop and lead a methodology for standardizing clinical workflows across a large regional or provincial health system.

Establish consistent clinical workflow standards applicable to large, medium, and small hospital facilities.

Lead the implementation and localization of standardized workflows to accommodate facility-specific operational needs while preserving provincial standards.

Assess proposed local variations, document their rationale, evaluate their impact, and support formal review and approval through established governance processes.

Ensure workflow design promotes consistency, efficiency, patient safety, and effective care delivery across participating facilities.

3. Physician and Clinician Engagement

Develop and execute engagement and advocacy approaches for physician groups, nursing professionals, and other clinical stakeholders.

Engage physician leads and frontline clinicians in clinical workflow design, EHR/CIS configuration decisions, validation, and implementation planning.

Represent physician and clinician needs in clinical governance forums, design discussions, prioritization decisions, and issue resolution.

Facilitate collaboration between clinical stakeholders, program leadership, clinical operations, and technical delivery teams.

Ensure frontline clinical requirements are accurately reflected in approved workflows, system design, and implementation decisions.

4. Clinical Governance and Decision-Making

Establish, lead, or support clinical working groups, committees, and governance forums responsible for clinical workflows, EHR/CIS design, prioritization, and cross-site decisions.

Define decision-making processes, governance structures, escalation pathways, and accountability mechanisms.

Facilitate timely and transparent resolution of clinical design issues, competing priorities, and workflow conflicts.

Maintain documented decisions, approved requirements, priorities, risks, actions, and escalations.

Ensure governance decisions are communicated to relevant clinical, operational, informatics, and technical stakeholders.

5. Clinical Informatics and Technical Build Team Alignment

Manage the day-to-day relationship between clinical informatics and technical EHR/CIS build teams.

Translate clinical requirements, approved workflows, and clinical design decisions into clear functional requirements and build specifications.

Prioritize build requests and coordinate capacity, dependencies, competing requirements, and delivery timelines.

Resolve conflicts between clinical needs, technical constraints, and approved design standards.

Oversee delivery against approved requirements and ensure that system configuration reflects intended clinical workflows.

Establish effective processes for requirement traceability, design review, build validation, and issue resolution.

6. Technical Build Governance and Oversight

Provide leadership and oversight to technical EHR/CIS build teams.

Establish build governance, standardized build methodologies, configuration standards, and delivery processes.

Manage build priorities, resource capacity, work allocation, and competing demands.

Oversee system build, configuration, testing, release management, and deployment readiness.

Coordinate planning and impact assessments for major system changes, including code upgrades and other significant platform changes.

Ensure appropriate alignment between technical delivery, clinical requirements, system quality, and operational needs.

7. Clinical Workflow Validation, Testing, and Release Readiness

Define and lead clinical workflow validation, testing, release-readiness, and cutover approaches.

Coordinate clinical and technical testing cycles to verify that configured workflows meet approved requirements.

Assess system quality, clinical safety, operational readiness, and unresolved risks before deployment.

Establish and apply clear go/no-go criteria and provide release-readiness recommendations.

Develop and oversee clinical and technical cutover plans, including stakeholder coordination, issue escalation, and contingency considerations.

Ensure readiness decisions are supported by documented validation results, identified risks, and appropriate stakeholder approvals.

8. Patient Safety and Clinical Quality

Embed patient safety and clinical quality considerations into EHR/CIS design, configuration, validation, and implementation.

Apply comprehensive clinical informatics knowledge across clinical documentation, order management, order sets, clinical decision support, medication management, and workflow analysis.

Focus on medication systems and orders management to ensure the solution supports safe and reliable clinical practices.

Partner with Clinical Operations to translate intended safety and quality outcomes into practical operational improvements.

Identify clinical workflow risks, system-related safety concerns, and improvement opportunities and coordinate appropriate mitigation activities.

9. Go-Live, Incident Management, and Stabilization

Lead or support planning and execution for large-scale EHR/CIS activations from a clinical informatics perspective.

Coordinate clinical readiness activities, activation planning, command-centre operations, and incident-management processes.

Support clinical incident triage, prioritization, escalation, and resolution during implementation and stabilization.

Monitor clinical workflow performance and system issues following deployment.

Coordinate stabilization activities and transition the program toward sustained operations and continuous optimization.

Ensure clinical stakeholders receive the support required to maintain safe and effective care delivery during system transitions.

10. Clinician Education, Adoption, and Optimization

Develop and support clinician education strategies and learning materials for new and revised clinical workflows.

Apply adult learning principles to training design, delivery, and evaluation.

Coordinate clinician readiness, adoption support, and communication activities.

Evaluate education effectiveness and identify opportunities to strengthen user confidence and system utilization.

Lead post-go-live optimization activities based on clinician feedback, operational performance, workflow issues, and lessons learned.

Support continuous improvement of clinical workflows and system usability.

11. Clinical Informatics Team Leadership and Enterprise EHR/CIS Experience

Build, lead, mentor, and develop clinical informatics teams supporting enterprise-scale EHR/CIS implementation and optimization.

Provide direction, coaching, and oversight to clinical informatics personnel and multidisciplinary delivery teams.

Apply experience with a major enterprise EHR/CIS platform to the platform selected for the Symbio Program.

Establish sustainable team practices, operating procedures, and knowledge-sharing mechanisms.

Promote collaboration across clinical, operational, informatics, and technical teams.

12. Knowledge Transfer and Capability Development

Mentor and develop New Brunswick program personnel throughout the engagement.

Transfer practical knowledge, skills, methodologies, and expertise in clinical workflow standardization, facilitation, governance, validation, and documentation.

Develop and maintain reusable processes, guidance, and documentation that support continuity of clinical informatics operations.

Enable internal program personnel to independently apply established practices and sustain the program beyond the engagement.

Support the long-term maturity and self-sufficiency of the province's clinical informatics capabilities.

Requirements

Mandatory Requirements

Candidates must explicitly demonstrate compliance with every mandatory requirement
. Relevant education, roles, responsibilities, project experience, and employment dates must be clearly documented.
M1 – Education and Equivalent Experience

A bachelor's degree from a recognized institution in Nursing, Health Informatics, Health Sciences, or a related field; OR

An equivalent combination of education and demonstrated senior clinical informatics experience with CIS implementations.

M2 – Clinical Informatics and EHR/CIS Experience

Minimum 10 years of experience
in clinical informatics, large-scale EHR/CIS implementation or optimization, and clinical workflow design within a health system.

Demonstrated progressive leadership responsibility throughout the relevant experience.

M3 – Senior Leadership in a Multi-Site Acute Care Environment

Minimum 5 years of experience
in a leadership or high-level advisory role.

Experience leading clinical informatics teams, EHR/CIS build teams, or clinical workflow teams within a multi-site acute care health system.

About Citco

JOB DESCRIPTION

The market leader. The premier provider. The best in the business. At Citco, we’ve been the front-runner in our field since our incorporation in 1948 led to the evolution of the asset servicing sector itself. This pioneering spirit continues to guide us today as we innovate and expand, push beyond the boundaries of our industry, and shape its future. From working exclusively with hedge funds to serving all alternatives, corporations and private clients, our organization has grown immensely across asset classes and geographies. For us, this progress is a pattern that we’ll only maintain as we move forward, always prioritizing our performance. So for those who want to play at the top of their game and be at the vanguard of their space, we say: Welcome to Citco.

About The Team & Business Line

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.

A challenging and exciting role in a rapidly growing industry, Portfolio Analytics services across a diverse client base spanning hedge funds, private markets and multi-asset strategies across North America, the United Kingdom, Continental Europe and Asia. The Vice President of the Portfolio Analytics group will take a senior leadership role managing existing US client relationships, ensuring client retention, and driving sales, marketing and business development initiatives across the region. The team provides ad-hoc and regulatory risk reports that include, but are not limited to, exposure and P&L reports, limits monitoring, scenario analysis, stress testing, value-at-risk and fund performance analytics - supporting clients across a broad range of strategies and structures.

The role provides a unique opportunity to work closely with a wide range of securities, derivatives and structured products in many currencies traded across global markets, and to lead the build-out of a structured, high-performing client service model across the US book. The individual's duties will include, but are not limited to, client onboarding project management, senior client relationship leadership, team management, and the training and development of staff — mirroring and helping to embed a proven operating model already established elsewhere in the group.

Responsibilities

Your Role:

Business Development & Commercial Acumen — Take an active, leading role in the CFS 'new business acquisition' process from a Portfolio Analytics perspective, effectively demonstrating our suite of Portfolio Analytics services to potential clients as well as new or enhanced services to existing clients, positioning this as a core driver of the role; evaluate the viability of current and new business proposals with emphasis on tactical issues and barriers
Client Relationship Management — Own and lead senior client relationships across the US book, participating in regular client calls and working closely with the global Client Integration team who oversee and project manage the firm-wide onboarding process
Reporting of Client KPIs — Own and maintain the KPI and RAG framework across the US client base, supervising junior team members in day-to-day tracking and reporting to support senior management oversight
Team Leadership & Management — Provide day-to-day leadership and management of the US Portfolio Analytics team, embedding a structured, KPI-driven client service model and ensuring consistent standards of client oversight and RAG reporting across the book
Communication — Use appropriate interpersonal styles and techniques to gain acceptance and help others understand the importance of the vision on the day-to-day reality of the risk reporting process
Building Networks - Proactively build strong relationships with Client Service and Business Development colleagues across CFS offices as a first priority, while also networking across departments (Valuation/Profit & Loss, Operations, Internal Audit, Integration, etc.) to establish collaborative business relationships at all levels and facilitate the accomplishment of business objectives
Leading & Managing Others — Embody the CFS culture, lead and inspire team through change, encourage others to seek opportunities for different approaches to address problems and opportunities
Organization & Resource Management — Oversee the US team with responsibility for pre-sales, onboarding, client coverage planning, and other new business initiatives
Building and Retaining Organizational Talent —Focus on identifying, developing, deploying and retaining key talent within the US team (including succession planning) for the future success of CFS, initiating strategies to develop internal talent through ongoing training and conducting timely performance evaluations.
Operational Decision-making — Commit and take responsibility for tactical decisions, adopting innovative approaches to move resolution of challenges to completion; communicate outcomes to all stakeholders and contribute to CFS vision and strategy
Execution — Execute business strategy by aligning communication, accountabilities, skills, internal processes and measurement to ensure sustainable and profitable results
Client Risk & Continuity Oversight — Identify and manage clients with elevated customisation and key person risk, ensuring documented continuity plans are in place and escalating concentration risk where appropriate

Qualifications

About You:

Drive for Results — Possessing an energetic and tenacious achievement orientation; proactively seeking opportunities to drive performance of self and team, and setting stretching goals; managing personal and group strengths and opportunities
Navigating Complexity — Proactively and quickly making sense of complex issues where ambiguity exists; communicating complicated information concisely and logically
Excellent analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with proven ability to summarise and interpret client requirements
Aspiration to become a subject matter expert in proprietary risk solutions
Someone who enjoys project-based work, collaboration across teams, and dealing directly with clients — no two days the same
Quantitative background with a Bachelor's/higher level degree or professional qualification (MSc, PhD, CQF, FRM, PRMIA, GARP, CFA, FIA)
Proficient in Excel, VBA, SQL, with Python experience in particular advantageous
Knowledge of business intelligence tools such as Qlik Sense (or Tableau) and Jaspersoft is a plus
7–10 years' experience in investment and regulatory risk reporting and performance analytics in funds/asset management/banking/insurance - including hedge fund, private markets and multi-asset strategies , with demonstrated experience in client relationship leadership, team management, pre-sales, onboarding and business development
Prior experience managing or supervising a client-facing team is required
Knowledge of market, credit, liquidity and counterparty risk measurement and management under regulatory frameworks such as Form PF, Form CPO-PQR, Annex IV, Basel III/CRD IV/CRR and Solvency II is advantageous
Candidates must be willing to travel to the United States for business purposes

Salary Range:
$115,000 - 155,000

Our Benefits

Your well-being is of paramount importance and central to our success here at Citco. Citco offers a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package to support your career success and personal needs. Your base salary will be determined by several factors such as the role, experience, skillset, market conditions, etc. Furthermore, qualifying positions can participate in an annual discretionary bonus pool based on company profitability and individual contributions. Experience integrating GenAI or agentic platforms with measurable outcomes

Corporate Strategy & Planning:

Support the annual strategic planning cycle with the CEO, CFO, and business leaders, translating strategy into measurable targets and KPIs.

Lead portfolio and asset rationalization reviews, including consolidation of facilities, product lines, and legal entities, and divestiture of non-core assets.
Design and support internal reorganizations, including changes to organizational structure, reporting lines, and operating models.
Build business cases that quantify financial, operational, and people impacts, and track realization of expected benefits after implementation.
Coordinate cross-functional project teams and external consultants to deliver projects on time and on budget.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management:

Build and lead a high-performing corporate development and strategy function within the company, earning credibility across the organization by consistently adding value.
Manage relationships with investment banks, advisors, valuation firms, legal firms, private equity investors, and prospective partners.

Exceptional communicator—able to craft clear narratives for financial and non-financial audiences.

new_jobs.description:
A propos de l'équipe

L’équipe TI et Transformation des Affaires
est une fonction mondiale relevant directement du PDG de Graitec. Elle est composée de quatre équipes : Transformation des Affaires, Données et IA, Sécurité de l’Information, et Opérations TI et Plateformes
. Ensemble, nous assurons les capacités opérationnelles qui permettent à Graitec de fonctionner efficacement et nous accompagnons sa transformation continue.

Nous travaillons en équipes fusionnées
, où les expert(e)s des affaires et des technologies collaborent autour d’objectifs communs et de résultats concrets.
L’équipe Opérations TI et Plateformes
soutient quotidiennement l’ensemble de l’organisation : plateformes d’affaires, infrastructure infonuagique, environnement numérique de travail et soutien aux utilisateurs. Son périmètre couvre notamment Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations
, Dynamics 365 CRM
, les outils de services professionnels, les systèmes RH, les plateformes clients et web, le centre de services TI, Microsoft Azure
, les réseaux et la gestion des identités. L’équipe dessert l’EMEA et l’Amérique du Nord et s’organise autour des domaines d’affaires qu’elle soutient.

Raison d’être du poste et contribution à la valeur d’affaires

Ce poste de direction est responsable de tout ce sur quoi les employés et les clients de Graitec comptent pour accomplir leur travail : les applications d’entreprise, l’infrastructure infonuagique et numérique ainsi que l’expérience globale de service TI.

Vous serez responsable de la qualité des services, de la fiabilité des plateformes, de la maîtrise des coûts et de la capacité de livraison. Plus qu’une fonction de soutien, vous agirez comme un partenaire stratégique auprès des équipes d’affaires, en bâtissant un environnement technologique agile, optimisé par l’IA et capable d’évoluer avec la croissance de l’entreprise.

Votre succès sera mesuré selon des indicateurs d’affaires tels que :

La productivité et l’expérience des employés;
La disponibilité, la performance et la résilience des plateformes;
L’optimisation des coûts opérationnels;
Les gains d’efficacité et d’échelle.

Ce que le succès représente dans les 12 premiers mois
Déployer un centre de services TI mondial axé sur l’expérience client, avec des niveaux de service publiés, un catalogue de services complet et des options libre-service largement adoptées. Les indicateurs de satisfaction (CSAT) et de recommandation (NPS) sont mesurés et en amélioration.
Assurer le soutien opérationnel complet du programme Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations
, avec un modèle d’exploitation et de soutien défini avant chaque mise en production.
Consolider l’environnement infonuagique et automatiser de bout en bout le cycle de vie des employés (arrivées, mobilités internes et départs).
Fournir une vision consolidée et fiable des coûts de plateformes, du positionnement des licences et de la performance des fournisseurs, tout en générant des économies.
Structurer les équipes comme une seule fonction intégrée, avec une taille optimale et une réduction des dépendances critiques.
Mettre en production une première vague d’initiatives d’IA et d’automatisation permettant de réduire les interventions manuelles et le volume de billets.
Renforcer la résilience opérationnelle grâce à des mécanismes éprouvés de sauvegarde et de relève informatique.

Responsabilités principales

Plateformes d’entreprise
Assurer la gestion complète du cycle de vie des plateformes d’entreprise : Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, CRM, solutions d’automatisation des services professionnels, systèmes RH et de paie ainsi que plateformes clients et web.
Collaborer avec l’équipe Transformation des Affaires pour assurer une transition harmonieuse des projets vers les opérations.
Travailler avec l’équipe Données et IA afin de garantir la qualité et la fiabilité des données.
Gérer les plateformes comme des produits : responsables identifiés, adoption mesurée et feuille de route alignée sur la valeur d’affaires.

Excellence des services TI
Développer une expérience de services TI mondiale alignée sur les meilleures pratiques ITIL et centrée sur l’utilisateur.
Définir et publier les niveaux de service et le catalogue de services.
Superviser la gestion des incidents, des problèmes et des changements à l’aide d’une plateforme ITSM moderne.
Assurer la gestion de l’environnement numérique de travail : Microsoft 365, Copilot, gestion des postes de travail et cycle de vie des employés.
Exploiter les données d’adoption et les commentaires des utilisateurs afin d’éliminer les causes récurrentes des demandes plutôt que de simplement les traiter.

IA et automatisation des opérations
Définir la stratégie d’intégration de l’IA au sein des opérations TI : résolution assistée ou automatisée, opérations auto-réparatrices et optimisation de l’environnement de travail numérique.
Collaborer avec les équipes Données et IA pour intégrer des solutions d’IA générant des bénéfices mesurables.
Mesurer et communiquer les gains obtenus : réduction des efforts manuels, diminution des délais de résolution et économies réalisées.

Infonuagique, infrastructure et résilience
Superviser les environnements Azure, les réseaux, la gestion des identités, les plateformes d’intégration et la modernisation des environnements existants.
Être responsable de la disponibilité, de la performance, de la sauvegarde, de la reprise après sinistre et de la résilience opérationnelle.
Promouvoir l’automatisation et l’infrastructure comme code afin de soutenir la croissance sans augmentation proportionnelle des effectifs.

Leadership et développement des équipes
Diriger et développer une équipe distribuée composée de gestionnaires d’infrastructure, de plateformes et de support.
Favoriser le développement des compétences, la relève et une culture d’imputabilité.
Accompagner les initiatives de gestion du changement pour assurer l’adoption des nouvelles façons de travailler.

Gestion des fournisseurs et des licences
Gérer les coûts des plateformes et de l’infrastructure, les licences et les relations avec les fournisseurs stratégiques.
Négocier les partenariats en fonction des résultats d’affaires recherchés.
Améliorer la transparence des coûts unitaires et démontrer les gains d’efficacité.
Construire les dossiers d’investissement pour les dépenses technologiques majeures et mesurer les bénéfices obtenus.

Sécurité de l’information et intégration d’acquisitions
Collaborer étroitement avec l’équipe Sécurité de l’Information afin d’intégrer les contrôles de sécurité, la gestion des accès, la conformité et les audits.
Soutenir les certifications telles que SOC 2 et ISO 27001.
Diriger l’intégration TI des acquisitions, de la préparation initiale à l’intégration complète dans l’architecture de l’entreprise.

Profil recherché

Expérience requise
Expérience significative à un poste de direction dans les opérations TI et la gestion d’applications d’entreprise dans un environnement international.
Expertise approfondie de l’écosystème Microsoft : Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, Dynamics 365 CRM, Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID et gestion moderne des postes de travail.
Expérience démontrée dans la mise en place de services TI orientés client et hautement performants.
Participation à des programmes majeurs de modernisation ERP et transition vers les opérations courantes.
Solide expérience de gestion des coûts, des licences, des fournisseurs et de l’intégration TI lors d’acquisitions.
Réalisations concrètes en matière d’IA et d’automatisation à grande échelle.
Capacité à interagir avec les équipes de direction et à présenter clairement les coûts, les risques, les bénéfices et le retour sur investissement.
Leadership calme et efficace en situation de crise ou lors d’incidents majeurs.

Atouts
Certification ITIL v4, TOGAF ou équivalent.
Certification PMP, PgMP ou équivalent.
Expérience dans un environnement multisociété et multinational.
Expérience au sein d’une entreprise en forte croissance, active en acquisition ou soutenue par du capital-investissement.

Processus d'entretien

Diversité et inclusion

Chez Graitec
, nous sommes fiers de promouvoir un milieu de travail inclusif où chacun peut être authentique et contribuer pleinement à notre succès. Nous accueillons les candidatures de toutes origines et évaluons chaque personne uniquement en fonction de ses compétences, de son expérience et de sa capacité à réussir dans le rôle.
Graitec utilise l’intelligence artificielle pour soutenir certains processus internes. Toutefois, toutes les décisions liées au recrutement, à l’évaluation des candidatures et à l’embauche sont prises exclusivement par notre équipe Acquisition de talents et nos gestionnaires recruteurs.

Is this role right for you? In this role, you will:

Lead the transformation of Global HR’s data, analytics, reporting and visualization capabilities to improve data-driven decision making and accelerate insights at scale to help each line of business optimize human capital.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

What You'll Be Doing

The Marketing and Client Solutions Decision Sciences ( Growth) team is at the center of our Media practice, strategy and innovation at CIBC. Its sole focus is to efficiently drive growth in reach and conversions through efficient media investments that are data driven. We work across different enterprise teams at CIBC and Simplii helping them understand and serve our clients and Canadians better each day. We apply best practices in marketing measurement, descriptive and predictive analysis, machine learning, artificial intelligence and leverage the latest in big data technology platforms.

Reporting into the COE Lead for Marketing and Client solutions within AI Data and Analytics, this role is responsible for leading a Media decision sciences practice, delivering on strategic priorities, managing and maintaining team operations and senior stakeholder relationships, equipping the Media Ops teams with high quality and timely data and insights to continuously optimize our Media. This Director will lead, manage and mentor a small team of Junior and Media scientists. This role requires a hands-on approach to solving problems, planning and managing change related to all aspects of marketing sciences delivery.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You'll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you'll spend 1-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote.

How You'll Succeed

Champion media analytics as a strategic growth driver — Serve as the trusted analytics partner to marketing, retail, wealth, and distribution leaders by translating business priorities into clear media measurement, experimentation, and optimization strategies. Ensure solutions are practical, scalable, and aligned to business outcomes.
Lead measurement, experimentation, and optimization across the media ecosystem — Oversee the design, implementation, and ongoing evaluation of analytics frameworks, models, and test-and-learn programs that improve media effectiveness. Guide the team in applying advanced analytics, AI/ML, and emerging GenAI capabilities to both structured and unstructured data, with a strong focus on campaign performance, attribution, audience insights, and investment optimization.
Deliver end-to-end analytical solutions — Lead work from problem definition and methodology through execution, validation, monitoring, and refinement. Continuously evolve approaches as business needs shift, new channels emerge, or performance insights suggest optimization opportunities.
Build a high-performing analytics function — Lead, coach, and develop a strong team of media analytics professionals. Hire and nurture talent with the right blend of analytical rigor, business acumen, and media expertise. Set clear expectations, remove barriers, and ensure the team is aligned to business priorities and enterprise goals.
Embed responsible, effective analytics practices — Foster high standards in measurement design, data quality, experimentation discipline, and responsible AI use. Ensure the team’s work adheres to relevant policies, governance standards, and best practices while maintaining credibility with partners across the organization.

Who You Are

You are a media analytics leader first. You bring strong command of the media landscape and understand how to connect channels, audiences, and investments to measurable business outcomes. You are fluent in media effectiveness, incrementality, attribution, testing, and optimization.
You combine craft expertise with strategic thinking. You know how to move from business question to analytical approach to actionable recommendation. You are comfortable shaping measurement strategies that inform planning, improve performance, and support better investment decisions.
You are highly analytical and experimentally minded. You have deep experience applying advanced analytics to marketing and media use cases, including forecasting, audience analysis, causal measurement, optimization, and performance diagnostics. You understand how to structure rigorous experiments and use evidence to guide decisions.
You are digitally and technically fluent. You are comfortable working with modern analytics and data science tools such as Python, SQL, Pandas, scikit-learn, and cloud-based data environments. About The Role

The VP, Data and AI Foundations is an enterprise executive leadership role accountable for defining, governing, and executing SE Health's end-to-end data and AI ecosystem. This role owns the strategy, architecture, engineering, analytics, governance, and business integration of data and artificial intelligence assets across the organization.

This position provides executive oversight for enterprise data strategies, advanced analytics, machine learning/Generative AI capabilities, data architecture, information governance, business intelligence, and responsible AI ethics frameworks. The VP partners with senior executives, clinical operations, technology leadership, legal/privacy teams, and external strategic partners to transform raw enterprise data into actionable intelligence, predictive insights, automated workflows, and measurable business and clinical outcomes.

Enterprise Impact and Scope

Sets enterprise direction for data management, business intelligence, predictive/prescriptive analytics, and enterprise AI adoption strategies.
Accountable for establishing data quality, metadata management, data architecture integration, and AI ethical guardrails in alignment with organizational risk posture and regulatory standards.
Provides executive leadership for the design, scaling, and monetization/operationalization of machine learning models, Generative AI applications, and algorithmic automation.
Builds executive alignment, algorithmic trust, and scalable data-driven operating models that empower enterprise clinical, financial, and operational decision-making.

What You'll Do

Enterprise Data & AI Strategy, Investment & Governance

Enterprise Direction: Sets the enterprise vision, strategic priorities, operating model and multi-year roadmap for data and AI, aligned with SE Health’s organizational strategy, care transformation and growth objectives.
Investment Stewardship: Establishes portfolio priorities and provides executive oversight of operating and capital investments, business cases, funding recommendations and benefits realization across the data and AI portfolio.
Enterprise Standards: Establishes and approves enterprise standards for data architecture, quality, stewardship, interoperability, access, platforms and responsible AI, ensuring alignment with security, privacy, legal, clinical and regulatory requirements.
Decision Authority: Chairs or sponsors enterprise governance forums; resolves cross-enterprise priorities and trade-offs; and recommends whether initiatives should proceed, change course or stop based on strategic fit, risk, readiness and expected value.

Business Transformation, AI Adoption & Value Realization

Transformation Portfolio: Partners with executive and business leaders to identify and prioritize enterprise opportunities where data and AI can transform care delivery, client and employee experience, workforce capacity, productivity, quality, growth and financial performance.
Product and Delivery Accountability: Provides executive oversight for the end-to-end portfolio of analytics, automation and AI products, ensuring disciplined progression from discovery and experimentation through deployment, adoption, scaling and ongoing optimization.
Business Adoption: Establishes shared accountability with business owners for workflow redesign, change readiness, adoption and sustained use of data and AI capabilities across clinical and corporate functions.
Benefits Realization: Defines enterprise performance measures and holds the portfolio accountable for measurable clinical, operational, financial and strategic outcomes, including quality, safety, productivity, user adoption and return on investment.

Enterprise Risk, Privacy & Responsible AI

Risk Framework: Establishes the enterprise data and AI risk framework in partnership with Privacy, Legal & Compliance, Security, Clinical, Technology and other control functions, aligned with organizational risk appetite and regulatory obligations.
Responsible AI: Sets guardrails for ethical, transparent, explainable and equitable use of data and AI, including human oversight, bias monitoring, model validation, third-party risk and appropriate use of sensitive health information.
Executive Assurance: Provides executive visibility into material data and AI risks, control effectiveness, regulatory developments and emerging exposures, with clear recommendations and escalation pathways.
Ongoing Oversight: Ensures deployed data and AI products are monitored for safety, accuracy, security, performance, drift and unintended impacts, and initiates timely remediation where required.

Executive Partnership & Ecosystem Leadership

Executive Advisory: Serves as a trusted advisor to the Chief Digital Officer, CEO and senior leadership on enterprise data and AI strategy, investment choices, opportunities, risks and organizational readiness.
Enterprise Alignment: Builds shared ownership across clinical, operational, financial and corporate leaders and resolves competing priorities, dependencies and decision rights across the enterprise.
Commercial and Partner Strategy: Leads strategic vendor and partner relationships, including build-buy-partner decisions, commercial negotiations, performance governance, technology viability, cost optimization and responsible commercialization opportunities where appropriate.
External Leadership: Represents SE Health in relevant health-sector, technology, research and policy forums, strengthening strategic partnerships, sector influence and access to emerging capabilities.

People, Culture & Organizational Capability

Organizational Leadership: Designs and leads a high-performing, multidisciplinary Data & AI function with clear mandates, accountabilities, decision rights and performance expectations aligned to enterprise priorities.
Talent and Succession: Leads workforce planning, talent acquisition, leadership development, performance management and succession planning for critical data and AI capabilities, balancing internal capacity with strategic external expertise.
Enterprise Capability: Builds data literacy, responsible AI fluency and decision-making capability across the organization so leaders and teams can use data and AI confidently, safely and effectively.
Culture and Leadership: Fosters an inclusive, collaborative and accountable culture that encourages innovation, constructive challenge, continuous learning and disciplined execution.

What You Bring

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
MBA or Master's degree in a related discipline considered an asset.(MS/MBA in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or AI).
Relevant certifications considered an asset (e.g., Azure Data/AI Engineer, AWS Certified Machine Learning, Google Cloud Data Engineer, CIPP privacy certification, CDMP, or equivalent).
15+ years of progressive technology and data leadership experience, including senior executive accountability over enterprise data systems, business intelligence, data science, and enterprise platform delivery.
Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating modern data stack architectures (Data Warehouses, Lakehouses, MLOps platforms) within complex enterprise environments.
Proven track record of deploying machine learning models, predictive tools, or Generative AI solutions into core production workflows to drive business value.
Demonstrated experience managing financial planning, cloud consumption/compute budgets, investment prioritization, and portfolio governance for data and AI programs.
In-depth knowledge of health data standards, data privacy laws (e.g., PHIPA, PIPEDA), clinical data structures, and ethical AI/governance frameworks.
Experience establishing data governance bodies, data stewardship programs, and enterprise data quality processes.

Why Join SE Health?

At SE Health, you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare while contributing to a purpose-driven organization committed to innovation, impact, and social good. You will work alongside passionate leaders who believe that sustainable healthcare requires bold thinking, meaningful partnerships, and a relentless focus on improving lives.

Competitive Total Rewards So much more than a paycheque! Enjoy comprehensive benefits, pension, flexible pay options, car-loan support, housing solutions and exclusive staff perks.
Flexibility & Belonging Thrive with hybrid work, flexible scheduling and a supportive, inclusive culture that puts people first.
Purpose & Impact Join a national social enterprise where your voice matters. Every role helps advance health, spark innovation and strengthen communities across Canada.
Growth That Meets Your Ambition Access tuition support, training and meaningful career pathways across a growing, future-focused organization.

new_jobs.description:
Nutrien is a leading provider of crop inputs and services, and our business results make a positive impact on the world. Our purpose, Feeding the Future , is the reason we come to work each day. We’re guided by our culture of care and our core values: We put safety first. We act with integrity. We are stronger together. We deliver with excellence.

Through the collective expertise of our nearly 26,000 employees, we operate a world-class network of production, distribution, and ag retail facilities. We efficiently serve growers' needs and strive to provide a more profitable, sustainable, and secure future for all stakeholders.  Help us raise the expectation of what an agriculture company can be and grow your career with Nutrien.

Nutrien is looking for a Director, Data Governance to build and lead our enterprise data governance program—strengthening data ownership, quality, and controls across key data domains so Nutrien can confidently scale analytics, AI, and digital products. Reporting to the Sr Director, Data Office, you will partner across business, technology, and risk functions to set standards, enable adoption, and ensure regulatory, and policy requirements are met globally.

This role will ensure critical data at Nutrien is trusted, consistent, and compliant across all data domains and business areas. You will operate at the intersection of business, data, technology, and risk—enabling scalable analytics, AI, and digital products globally—while ensuring regulatory and policy requirements are met and maintained.

What You'll Do

Support the design and implementation of Nutrien’s global data governance framework across core data domains (e.g., product, customer, supplier, location, and asset)
Define enterprise standards for master/reference data domains and critical data elements
Drive the implementation of governance ownership and accountability across all data domains and lines of business, partnering with domain leaders to clarify roles, responsibilities, and adoption of governance practices
Balance enterprise consistency with business needs, regulatory requirements, and regional/functional nuances
Facilitate and support enterprise and business unit data governance forums (e.g., councils and working groups) ensuring alignment, issue escalation, and effective decision making
Drive continuous improvement of governance practices as the data and AI landscape evolves
Partner with IT and to define the enterprise data quality strategy, including standards, issue management, root-cause analysis, observability and remediation
Operationalize data governance policies and standards to ensure alignment with global and regional regulatory requirements (e.g., data privacy, residency, and confidentiality), working closely with Legal, Risk, and IT partners
Lead a team delivering master data maintenance for multiple data domains at Nutrien
Partner with Legal, Risk, and Compliance to support audits, client due diligence, and regulatory inquiries related to data and analytics
Lead data governance initiatives and change adoption efforts, influencing stakeholders and enabling consistent governance practices across domains and functions

What You'll Bring

Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
15+ years of experience in data governance, data management, master data, or related enterprise data roles
5+ years of experience in a managerial role with demonstrated executive-level influence and stakeholder management, including leading governance councils and driving adoption across a matrixed organization
Proven experience building and launching a data governance program from the ground up
Experience operating in a global, matrixed organization with regional regulatory complexity
Deep knowledge of data governance concepts, frameworks, and best practices (e.g., DAMA-DMBOK)
Practical experience with ERP systems (specifically SAP), data hierarchies, and how master data is created and managed within large enterprises
Experience collaborating across multiple business areas and centralized functions within a large enterprise
Proven people leadership experience, with the ability to build, mentor, and scale a high-performing team and stewardship community

What You'll Get

Purpose-Driven Work – Make an impact as part of a global team feeding the future and support farmers locally and around the world

Thrive in a Strong Culture – Guided by our core values we put safety first, act with integrity, are stronger together, and deliver with excellence in a collaborative, high-performing environment
